NONE: › a substance found in urine and also made from ammonia, used in fertilizers, animal feed, and in the plastics industry
› a tube on each side of the body that takes urine from the kidney to the bladder
› the tube in most mammals that carries urine from the bladder out of the body. In males it also carries semen.
› relating to the urethra (= the tube that carries urine from the bladder)
› the situation when the urethra (= the channel that carries urine from the bladder) becomes abnormally narrow

example: Urethral stricture causes difficulty in passing urine.
尿道狹窄導致排尿困難。
